documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting 30Th October 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Kross Limited reported strong operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust demand in the commercial vehicles and trailer segments and increased capacity utilization. Management highlighted the commencement of commercial production of extruded axle beams and ongoing progress on backward integration initiatives like the seamless tube facility. While rising consumable and commodity costs pressured margins, recently concluded price revisions with OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support performance in the upcoming quarters. The company remains optimistic about end-market demand and is focused on cost discipline, operational efficiency, and expanding its export footprint. Kross Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust OEM demand in the M&HCV, trailer, and tractor segments.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2, keeping in line with historical trends.
guidance.quote: Based on our current indication, we expect Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2. Overall volumes and historically also H2 is always 20% up on H1.

guidance.claim: The company expects export volumes this year to be 45% higher than the previous year.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, we expect this year to be 45% higher than our previous year.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2.
guidance.quote: Q3 and Q4 volumes expected to be stronger than Q2 and historically also H2 is always 10-15% up than H1.

guidance.claim: Kross is positioned to deliver healthy growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: With healthy order books, sustained demand in the trailer and tractor segments, and multiple capacity expansion initiatives nearing completion, Kross is well positioned to deliver healthy growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects a growth of 40% to 45% in its exports for this financial year.
guidance.quote: We are looking into having a growth of 40%, 45% in our exports for this financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: The momentum in the commercial segment has continued with robust demand indicated by the OEMs.
demand_outlook.quote: The momentum in the commercial segment has continued with robust demand indicated by the OEMs.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the Agri segment has remained consistent, and management expects this momentum to continue into Q3.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand in the Agri segment has remained consistent. We expect this momentum to continue into Q3, supported by relatively lower inventory levels of tractors in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: The continued momentum in commercial vehicles, healthy tractor demand and planned ramp-up provide good growth opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: The continued momentum in commercial vehicles, healthy tractor demand and the planned ramp-up for our new products provide good opportunities of growth for us.

demand_outlook.claim: Momentum in the M&HCV segment continued with robust OEM demand.
demand_outlook.quote: M&HCV Segment: Momentum continued with robust OEM demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the tractor and agri segment remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: Tractor & Agri Segment: Demand remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports currently contribute approximately 8% of the total component business.
demand_outlook.quote: Exports now contribute approximately 8% of our total component business.

demand_outlook.claim: The M&HCV momentum from Q4 FY26 continued into Q1 FY27, with OEMs indicating a strong September Q2 and subsequently Q3 and Q4.
demand_outlook.quote: Regarding the M&HCV segment, the momentum in the CV segment from Q4 FY26 continued into Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Tractor demand has been consistent and remains on track to meaningfully increase its contribution to revenues over the coming years.
demand_outlook.quote: Regarding the Tractor segment, demand has been consistent, on track to increase contribution meaningfully over the coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: The trailer segment is projecting good volumes with continued growth in the CV market.
demand_outlook.quote: Regarding the Trailer segment, with continued growth in the CV market, the trailer segment is also projecting good volumes.

capex_expansion.claim: The company envisages expansion through strategic increases in axle shaft production and forward integration into cold drawn tubes.
capex_expansion.quote: The company further envisages expansion through strategic increase in axle shaft production, forward integration into manufacturing by making Cold Drawn Tubes and enhanced investment in robotic automation for forging operations as well as machining facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production of extruded axle beams has commenced with a capacity of 7,500 units per month.
capex_expansion.quote:
Commercial production of extruded axle beams has commenced
• Current axle beam capacity stands at 7,500 units per month

capex_expansion.claim: The seamless tube facility has its mills installed, with production trials targeted for February-March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Seamless tube facility: mills installed, production trials targeted for February–March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The high-pressure moulding line in the foundry is progressing as planned to double existing casting capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: High-pressure moulding line (Foundry) Progressing as planned to double existing casting capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The axle beam extrusion line has started production and is now in operation.
capex_expansion.quote: The extruded axle beam has started production and volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: A high-pressure mold line for the foundry is expected to start in Q3, doubling foundry capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: A high-pressure mold line for our foundry is expected to start in Q3. This will double our foundry capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: An axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: Progress on the seamless tube facility is on track, with the piercing mill received and other mills on the high seas.
capex_expansion.quote: Progress on the seamless tube facility is on track. Piercing mill has been received, sizing and straightening mills are on the high seas and this is progressing as per schedule.

margins_costs.claim: During Q2 FY '27, revenue from operations stood at INR235 crores with EBITDA margins of 13%.
margins_costs.quote: During Q2 FY '27, revenue from operations stood at INR235 crores, registering a growth of 80%. EBITDA was INR 30.6 crores and EBITDA margins of 13%, while profit after tax stood at INR (197) million, reflecting to a year-on-year change of 143%.

margins_costs.claim: The company has witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs.
margins_costs.quote: While we have witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs, the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.

margins_costs.claim: Price revisions with most OEMs and Tier-1 customers were concluded to support profitability despite input-cost pressures.
margins_costs.quote: Price revisions with most OEMs and Tier-1 customers concluded, supporting profitability despite input-cost pressures.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin was 43.9% in Q2 FY27.
EBITDA margin stood at 13.0% for Q2 FY27.
Q1 EBITDA margins expanded by 63 bps year-on-year to 12.23%, reflecting operational efficiency, better product mix, and backward integration benefits.
margins_costs.quote: The margins right now are at -- for quarter one are at 12.23%, up 63 bps Y-o-Y, reflecting Page 3 of 10 Kross Limited July 27, 2026 operational efficiency, a better product mix, and benefits from our backward integration.

margins_costs.claim: A recent steel price settlement retrospective to suppliers was given around July 15th at INR4,700 per kilo.
margins_costs.quote: This has just happened around the 15th of July where INR4,700 per kilo has been given.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q2, the trailer segment contributed close to 49% of revenue, while the component business contributed 51%.
orders_capacity.quote: If you look into our sales segment mix for this specific quarter, our trailer segment has contributed close to 49% of our revenue, while the component business contributed the balance 51%.

orders_capacity.claim: Q2 trailer axle volumes exceeded earlier record levels of Q4 of '26.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Q2 volumes have exceeded the earlier record levels of Q4 of '26.

orders_capacity.claim: Exports now contribute approximately 8% of the company's component business.
orders_capacity.quote: Exports now contribute approximately 8% of our component business.

orders_capacity.claim: Tipping jack installed capacity stands at 800 kits per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity of 800 kits/month providing substantial headroom for future growth.

orders_capacity.claim: Current utilization of the axle beam extrusion plant is approximately 60-65%.
orders_capacity.quote: Axle beam extrusion plant: Commercial production has commenced; current utilisation approximately 60–65%.

orders_capacity.claim: Volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: The extruded axle beam has started production and volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The tipping jacks facility has a manufacturing capacity of 800 numbers a month.
orders_capacity.quote: So as far as the utilization of it, we have a capacity to manufacture 800 numbers a month.

orders_capacity.claim: Overall axle volume in Q1 was almost at 9,500 numbers and suspension volumes were at around 3,200 to 3,300 numbers.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, the overall axle volume is almost at 9,500 numbers and the suspension volumes are at around 3,200, 3,300 numbers, both mechanical and air put together.

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed a preferential issue to the tune of INR63.6 crores to focus on capacity expansion and gearing up for future years.
capital_allocation.quote: The company is completely focused on capacity expansion and gearing up for the coming years, which is also witnessed by a preferential issue to the tune of INR63.6 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The total budgeted cost for the seamless tube project is approximately INR170 crores, funded by INR110 crores via term loan and the rest from internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, we -- the total budgeted cost is approximately INR170 crores, okay? Out of this is funded by INR110 crores via term loan. The rest is from internal accruals, okay?

capital_allocation.claim: The seamless tube facility is funded through a mix of debt and internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote:
Funded through a
mix of debt &
internal accruals

capital_allocation.claim: Fund utilization from the IPO has been fully utilized as per plan towards capacity expansion and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: On our fund utilization from the IPO, we have utilized fully as per the plan. This has been achieved and the funds deployed towards capacity expansion and working capital have been as per plan.

risks_headwinds.claim: The months of June and July are periods where demands are slightly subdued due to monsoon.
risks_headwinds.quote: The period of June, July are where demands are slightly subdued due to monsoon.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to undertake production trials for the seamless tube facility in February or March of 2027.
management_commitments.quote: The sizing mill and straightening mills have been received and installed, and we plan to undertake production trials in February or March of 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to produce trailer axles exclusively through the extruded beam process by Q3 or Q4.
management_commitments.quote: This particular aspect of business by Q3 or Q4, we will be producing our trailer axles in this methodology only by the extruded beam process.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects capacity utilization of expanded capacities to improve progressively over the coming 2 quarters.
management_commitments.quote: The investments we have made in the capacity expansion and operational capabilities are beginning to support our growth, and we expect the utilization of these expanded capacities to improve over the coming quarters.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets production trials for the seamless tube facility in February-March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Seamless tube facility: mills installed, production trials targeted for February–March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to take export contribution to around 8% in the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: We've mentioned this before is that the plan is to have at least 8% of exports coming in in the next two years' time.

management_commitments.claim: Production trials for the seamless tube facility are expected to be conducted by the end of this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So, I think by end of this financial year, we should be doing some production trials.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
